title: Donkey Kong Hypertrophy 4-Day U/L v7
author: kevbobo
desc:
Gain monkey muscle. SBL optimized for 4 day/wk.

Phase 1 (wk 1-4): Foundation, baselining
Deload (wk 5): No sets near failure.
Phase 2 (wk 6-9): Intensification, exercise rotation
Phase 3 (wk 10-13): Peak form, maximum effort

ex.note: Lead compound. Track weight × reps every week.
Flye negative, press positive. Chest stretch + overload.
Drive elbow back, squeeze lat at top.
Arms straight, pull with lats. Hi-low cable.
Upper back + rear delts. Light, high reps, squeeze.
Side delt. Draw a sword motion.

ss.note: SUPERSET — curl, immediately tri, rest 1.5 min.

ex.note: Lead compound. Heavier (6-7) fresh, lighter (8-10) fatigued.
Seat back max. 2-3 sec negatives. QUAD PRIORITY.
Maintain neutral low back, push hips back, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, don't bounce out of the bottom position
TEMPO: 3s neg, 1s pause at bottom. Feet high & wide.
Hi-low cable, ankle strap.
Stand on plate. 1-2 sec pause at bottom.
Pull-up bar. Controlled.
30° incline. Upper chest. Track for overload.
Last set: full reps + 4-5 partials in stretch.
Hi-low cable. Slight lean, elbows down and in.
Face down on incline bench. Squeeze shoulder blades.

ss.note: SUPERSET — pullover (lats), immediately rear delt flye (rear delts). Two birds, one time block.

ex.note: Side delts. Control the negative.
